### Sharks Way Feature Updates June 10, 2026 {#sharks-way-feature-updates-june-10,-2026}

**Wayfinding Shark Mode**:   
Maria & Jimmy Sharks appear alternately each time a shark is detected by the camera. The sharks approach as if coming from behind the viewer, pause for a moment in front of the viewer, and then swim off in the distance (no tapping necessary).  After a shark is detected, a prompt appears to ‘drop a shark’: users can place a Jimmy shark that loops through the swimming animation but doesn’t swim away and they walk around it.

* If Technically possible:  
  * Always have the sharks swimming West toward SAP (this might not be technically possible).

**Jumping Sharks**   
Sharks swim into frame and then jump up like ‘jumping out of water’, come back down with a splash.

**Underpass (location based always on):** Shark swims into frame from the east heading west. It jumps up like it’s jumping out of water at the intersection ([37.335391 (N), \-121.896682 (W)](https://maps.app.goo.gl/h5a54ezq6NF7gcBFA))  and comes back down before the underpass and continues swimming west under the freeway.

Tutorials for Grand Finale  
**Sharks Swimming in Circle** \- use follow path constraint and offset the frames to place the sharks at different places on the circle. [Animate an Object Along a Curve (Blender Tutorial)](https://youtu.be/VNs7DyEV6fA?si=eO4fyLYbvT3ZaB5R)

1. [Apply the Follow Path Constraint](https://youtu.be/ZK01KN5z5us) to each shark  
2. Set offset: You would set the animation frame offset that initial shark to offset X 1, the next parcel to offset X 2   
3. Save a copy of your design file (Working File) **VERY IMPORTANT TO MAKE A NEW FILE OTHERWISE YOU’LL LOSE EDITING CAPABILITIES**  
   1. Set the project end frame to the offset  
   2. [Bake the animation](https://youtu.be/omAoKWyG_J4) (the copy is the Baked File)  
   3. Export .gltf file (record file size) \*\*\* [Updated .gltf Export Settings From Blender for File Size Reduction](https://youtu.be/3GCzb0BjdHU)   
4. If you need to tweak the followpath animations return to your Working file and adjust the path (the belt & animation will adjust accordingly)
